name: Quad Crawler
description: Same frame as the Quad Strider but with a wave gait and hull sway (comShift): one leg up at a time and the hull leans toward the support triangle. Statically stable, half the speed.

proposal.summary: Shows the stability vs speed trade-off on an identical frame.
decisions: Same hull and mounts as quad-strider; gait, RPM and leg length differ.
Hull sway (comShift: 1) is done by the controller so players never tune it by hand.
Legs are 0.5 b longer per segment than the strider: the sway moves the hips and 3+3 legs over-reach on flat ground.
openQuestions: Is ~1.6 b/s too slow to feel good as a vehicle?
